title: a little gameplay of my current game project
author: JuyuLabs
selftext:
I mostly use Codex for the code and graphics, although I still draw some of the sprites myself.

The AI art was objectively way better, but somehow I fell in love with my own trashy little art style. So now I'm slowly replacing the nice generated stuff with my cursed handmade sprites, one by one.

As for the code... I completely lost control of that a long time ago. I have basically no idea how half of this game works anymore, and understanding the codebase has become an optional side quest.

But honestly, that's fine

At this point I've fully accepted it for what it is: an AI-powered fever dream held together by Codex, questionable decisions, and cursed homemade art.

I'm also planning to release a demo very soon! If this weird little project looks even remotely interesting to you, I'd really appreciate a wishlist on Steam — it helps a lot :)
